purpose: Define deterministic validation preventing reserved-root shadowing, duplicate active mounts, ambiguous dynamic children and incompatible namespace ownership.

topics.name: Namespace Collision Validation
topics.purpose: Define deterministic validation preventing reserved-root shadowing, duplicate active mounts, ambiguous dynamic children and incompatible namespace ownership.

semantics.dynamic_rule: Dynamic family children are unique within their family scope.
semantics.mount_rule: Two active mounts cannot claim the same exact semantic address unless explicit multiplex/composition semantics permit it.
semantics.owner_rule: Conflicting semantic owners for one active address hard-fail.
semantics.validation_rule: Collisions are detected before affected mount/activation becomes available.
semantics.no_repair_rule: Validator does not silently rename conflicting namespaces.

invariants.rule: Runtime symbol namespaces, roots, mounts and dynamic families are explicit, collision-free and never inferred solely from filesystem layout or display labels.

hard_gates.condition: same exact address has conflicting active owners

references.purpose: Namespace validity contributes to whole-tree/runtime conformance.

prose.summary: Define deterministic validation preventing reserved-root shadowing, duplicate active mounts, ambiguous dynamic children and incompatible namespace ownership.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against existing runtime symbol/module contracts and whole-tree Contract Format 1.4 validation.
